# OG Preview: link preview checker and meta tag generator

> Free, browser-only tool that shows how a link looks when shared on Google, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Slack, Discord, iMessage and WhatsApp. Paste a page's HTML (or use the bookmarklet), see unofficial lookalike previews, get a list of problems with fixes (missing og:image, wrong image size or ratio, relative image URLs, title and description length measured in pixels, missing twitter:card or canonical, duplicate tags, broken JSON-LD), and generate a clean head snippet. No sign-up, no tracking; the HTML never leaves the browser.

URL: https://lab.zalastack.com/og-preview/

## Key facts (checked 2026-10-21)

- Use one og:image at 1200 x 630 px (1.91:1), PNG or JPG, under 5 MB, absolute https URL.
- Facebook: recommends at least 1200 x 630; minimum 200 x 200; max 8 MB; under 600 x 315 shows small.
- LinkedIn: at least 1200 x 627, 1.91:1, max 5 MB; under 401 px wide shows as a thumbnail.
- X summary_large_image: about 2:1, min 300 x 157, max 4096 x 4096, under 5 MB. summary: 1:1, min 144 x 144.
- Slack, Discord, iMessage, WhatsApp: no published size; 1200 x 630 works. For WhatsApp, a small file (around 300 KB) is recommended.
- Google cuts titles near 600 px wide (about 50 to 60 characters) and descriptions after about two lines (about 150 to 160 characters). These are observed, not official.
- Minimum tags: title, meta description, canonical, og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type, twitter:card. X falls back to og tags for title, description and image.
- Refresh caches with LinkedIn Post Inspector (https://www.linkedin.com/post-inspector/) and the Facebook Sharing Debugger (https://developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/).
